description: This file defines a utility class 'Utils' in the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace, which provides static methods for managing promise task queues, creating promises, inspecting promise states, waiting on promises, and orchestrating multiple promises (e.g., all, some, any, settle). It appears to be a core utility implementation for promise handling within the Guzzle HTTP client package.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: Final class providing static utility methods for managing promise tasks, creation, inspection, and orchestration within the GuzzleHttp promise library.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Gets or sets the global task queue used for promise resolution; optionally assigns a new queue instance.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Schedules a callable task to run in the task queue and returns a promise that will be fulfilled or rejected based on the task execution.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Synchronously inspects a promise to determine its state and value or reason if rejected.

methods.name: inspectAll
methods.description: Inspects all promises in an iterable, returning their states.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Waits on all promises to resolve and returns their fulfilled values, throwing if any are rejected.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills when all provided promises are fulfilled, or rejects if any promise rejects.

methods.name: some
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled when a specified count of promises have fulfilled, or rejects if not enough promises fulfill.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with the first fulfilled promise's value among a set of promises; rejects if none fulfill.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills with an array of the inspection states of all promises, regardless of whether they fulfilled or rejected.
